title: YNX Browser — Private browsing with explicit Wallet review
metaDescription: Browse with platform-native engines, isolated private state and exact Wallet review boundaries.
h1: Browsing that keeps signing authority in Wallet
features: Exact Wallet review and callback binding
Crash recovery and selective data deletion
risks: The current macOS window-fix preview is ad-hoc signed and not notarized.
Windows and positive shared-Testnet Wallet callback evidence remain incomplete; the current-source macOS build and window behavior are verified locally, while its install record remains unproved.
No hosted artifact, public deployment or store release is claimed.

faq.question: Can YNX Browser sign transactions?
faq.answer: No. It constructs bounded requests and hands the exact review to Wallet.

faq.question: Is the macOS build production signed?
faq.answer: No. Current evidence is limited to a local ad-hoc-signed Testnet preview.
